description_en: Queries the details of an Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance
description_zh: 查询指定负载均衡实例的详细信息
name: GetLoadBalancerAttribute

schema.description_en: The details of the ALB instance configuration
schema.description_zh: 应用型负载均衡实例详细配置信息

AccessLogConfig.description_en: The configuration of the access log feature

AddressAllocatedMode.description_en:
The mode in which IP addresses are allocated. Valid values:

Fixed: allocates a static IP address to the ALB instance.
Dynamic: dynamically allocates an IP address to each zone of the ALB instance
AddressAllocatedMode.description_zh:
地址模式。取值 ：

Fixed：固定IP模式，表示使用固定的IP地址。

Dynamic：动态IP模式，表示在每个可用区动态分配IP地址

AddressIpVersion.description_en:
The IP version. Valid values:

IPv4
DualStack
AddressIpVersion.description_zh:
协议版本。取值：

IPv4：IPv4类型
DualStack：双栈类型

AddressType.description_en:
The network type of the ALB instance. Valid values:

Internet: The ALB instance uses a public IP address. The domain name of the ALB instance is resolved to the public IP address. Therefore, the ALB instance can be accessed over the Internet.
Intranet: The ALB instance uses a private IP address. The domain name of the ALB instance is resolved to the private IP address. In this case, the ALB instance can be accessed over the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the ALB instance is deployed
AddressType.description_zh:
应用型负载均衡实例的网络地址类型。取值：

Internet：负载均衡具有公网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到公网IP，因此可以在公网环境访问。

Intranet：负载均衡只有私网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到私网IP，因此只能被负载均衡所在VPC的内网环境访问

BandwidthPackageId.description_en: The ID of the elastic IP address (EIP) bandwidth plan that is associated with the Internet-facing ALB instance
BandwidthPackageId.description_zh: 公网类型实例关联的共享带宽包ID

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 资源创建时间，使用格林威治时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`

DNSName.description_en: The domain name of the ALB instance

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the deletion protection feature is enabled. Valid values:

true
false
Enabled.description_zh:
删除保护状态，取值：

true：开启状态。

false：关闭状态

EnabledTime.description_en: The time when the deletion protection feature was enabled. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
EnabledTime.description_zh: 删除保护开启时间，使用格林威治时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`

DeletionProtectionConfig.title_en: 负载均衡删除保护相关信息
DeletionProtectionConfig.title_zh: 负载均衡删除保护相关信息

Ipv6AddressType.description_en:
The type of IPv6 address that is used by the ALB instance. Valid values:

Internet: The ALB instance uses a public IP address. The domain name of the ALB instance is resolved to the public IP address. Therefore, the ALB instance can be accessed over the Internet.
Intranet: The ALB instance uses a private IP address. The domain name of the ALB instance is resolved to the private IP address. Therefore, the ALB instance can be accessed over the VPC in which the ALB instance is deployed
Ipv6AddressType.description_zh:
应用型负载均衡IPv6的网络地址类型。取值：

Internet：公网。负载均衡具有公网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到公网IP，因此可以在公网环境访问。
Intranet：私网。负载均衡只有私网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到私网IP，因此只能被负载均衡所在VPC的内网环境访问

LoadBalancerBillingConfig.description_en: The billing method of the ALB instance
LoadBalancerBillingConfig.description_zh: 应用型负载均衡实例计费配置

PayType.description_en:
The billing method.

Only PostPay is returned, which indicates the pay-as-you-go billing method
PayType.description_zh:
计费类型。

取值： PostPay表示按量计费

LoadBalancerBussinessStatus.description_en:
The service status of the ALB instance. Valid values:

Abnormal
Normal
LoadBalancerBussinessStatus.description_zh:
应用型负载均衡的业务状态。取值：

Abnormal：异常状态。

Normal：正常状态

LoadBalancerEdition.description_en:
The edition of the ALB instance. The features and billing rules vary based on the edition of the ALB instance. Valid values:

Basic
Standard
StandardWithWaf
LoadBalancerEdition.description_zh:
应用型负载均衡的版本，不同版本有不同功能限制和计费策略。取值：

Basic：基础版。

Standard：标准版。

StandardWithWaf：WAF增强版

LoadBalancerName.description_en:
The name of the ALB instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter
LoadBalancerName.description_zh:
实例名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

LoadBalancerOperationLocks.description_en:
The type of the lock. Valid values:

SecurityLocked: The ALB instance is locked due to security reasons.
RelatedResourceLocked: The ALB instance is locked due to association issues.
FinancialLocked: The ALB instance is locked due to overdue payments.
ResidualLocked: The ALB instance is locked because the associated resources have overdue payments and the resources are released
LoadBalancerOperationLocks.description_zh: 应用型负载均衡操作锁配置

items.description_zh: 应用型负载均衡操作锁配置

LockReason.description_en: The reason why the ALB instance is locked. This parameter is valid only if LoadBalancerBussinessStatus is set to Abnormal
LockReason.description_zh: 锁定的原因。在LoadBalancerBussinessStatus为异常时有效

LockType.description_en:
The lock type. Valid values:

SecurityLocked: The ALB instance is locked due to security reasons.
RelatedResourceLocked: The ALB instance is locked due to other resources that are associated with the ALB instance.
FinancialLocked: The ALB instance is locked due to overdue payments.
ResidualLocked: The ALB instance is locked because the associated resources have overdue payments and the resources are released
LockType.description_zh:
锁定的类型。取值 ：

SecurityLocked：安全锁定。

RelatedResourceLocked：关联锁定。

FinancialLocked：欠费锁定。

ResidualLocked：残留锁定

LoadBalancerStatus.description_en:
The status of the ALB instance. Valid values:

Inactive: The ALB instance is disabled. ALB instances in the Inactive state do not forward traffic.
Active: The ALB instance is running.
Provisioning: The ALB instance is being created.
Configuring: The ALB instance is being modified.
CreateFailed: The system failed to create the ALB instance. In this case, you are not charged for the ALB instance. You can only delete the ALB instance
LoadBalancerStatus.description_zh:
应用型负载均衡实例状态。取值：

Inactive: 已停止，表示实例监听不会再转发流量。

Active: 运行中。

Provisioning：创建中。

Configuring：变配中。

CreateFailed：创建失败，此时不会产生费用，实例只能被删除

Reason.description_en:
The reason why the configuration read-only mode is enabled.

The name must be 2 to 128 character characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter.

This parameter takes effect only if Status is set to ConsoleProtection
Reason.description_zh:
开启修改保护的原因。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

仅在Status为ConsoleProtection时返回
Reason.title_en: 设置修改保护状态的原因
Reason.title_zh: 设置修改保护状态的原因

Status.description_en:
Specifies whether the configuration read-only mode is enabled. Valid values:

NonProtection: The configuration read-only mode is disabled. In this case, the value of the Reason parameter that you specify does not take effect. If you set Reason, the value is cleared.
ConsoleProtection: The configuration read-only mode is enabled. In this case, the value of the Reason parameter takes effect.****

If the parameter is set to ConsoleProtection, the configuration read-only mode is enabled. You cannot modify the configurations of the ALB instance in the ALB console. However, you can call API operations to modify the configurations of the ALB instance
Status.description_zh:
应用型负载均衡实例的修改保护状态。取值：

NonProtection：未开启修改保护。如有配置Reason，Reason会被强制置空。

ConsoleProtection：已开启控制台修改保护。如有配置Reason，Reason可生效。

当取值为ConsoleProtection，即开启修改保护后，用户不能通过负载均衡控制台修改实例配置，但可以通过调用API修改实例配置
Status.title_en: 负载均衡修改保护状态
Status.title_zh: 负载均衡修改保护状态

ModificationProtectionConfig.title_en: 负载均衡修改保护相关信息
ModificationProtectionConfig.title_zh: 负载均衡修改保护相关信息

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the ALB instance
RegionId.description_zh: 应用型负载均衡实例的地域ID

SecurityGroupIds.description_en: The IDs of the security groups to which the ALB instance is added
SecurityGroupIds.description_zh: 应用型负载均衡实例绑定的安全组ID集合

items.description_en: The ID of the security group to which the ALB instance is added
items.description_zh: 应用型负载均衡实例绑定的安全组ID

Tags.description_en:
The tag value.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`

Key.description_en:
The tag key.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`
Key.description_zh:
实例的标签键。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

Value.description_en:
The tag value.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`
Value.description_zh:
实例的标签值。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC in which the ALB instance is deployed

ZoneMappings.description_en: The mappings between zones and vSwitches. At most 10 zones are returned. If the current region supports two or more zones, at least two zones are returned
ZoneMappings.description_zh: 可用区及交换机映射列表，最多返回10个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上可用区，至少返回2个及以上可用区

items.description_en: The mappings between zones and vSwitches. At most 10 zones are returned. If the current region supports two or more zones, at least two zones are returned
items.description_zh: 可用区及交换机映射列表，最多返回10个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上可用区，至少返回2个及以上可用区

LoadBalancerAddresses.description_en: The address of the ALB instance

items.description_en: The address of the ALB instance

Address.description_en:
An IPv4 address.

This parameter takes effect when AddressIPVersion is set to IPv4 or DualStack. The network type is determined by the value of AddressType
Address.description_zh:
标识IPv4类型的IP地址。

AddressIPVersion为IPv4和DualStack均生效，公网或私网IP地址由AddressType决定

EipType.description_en:
The type of EIP. Valid values:

Common: an EIP.
Anycast: an Anycast EIP.

For more information about the regions in which ALB supports Anycast EIPs, see [Limits]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460727.html）
EipType.description_zh:
公网EIP的类型。取值：

Common：弹性公网IP，简称EIP。
Anycast：任播弹性公网IP，简称Anycast EIP。

ALB支持绑定Anycast EIP的地域，请参见[使用限制]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460727.html）

IntranetAddressHcStatus.description_en:
The health status of the private IPv4 address of the ALB instance. 
This parameter is returned only when the Status of the zone is Active.Valid values:

Healthy

Unhealthy
IntranetAddressHcStatus.description_zh:
应用型负载均衡实例私网IPv4地址探测状态。

只有可用区的状态为Active时才返回。取值：

Healthy：健康。
Unhealthy：异常

Ipv4LocalAddresses.description_en: The IPv4 link-local addresses. The IP addresses that the ALB instance uses to communicate with the backend servers
Ipv4LocalAddresses.description_zh: IPv4 Local地址列表。ALB与后端服务交互使用的地址列表

Ipv6Address.description_en:
An IPv6 address.

This parameter takes effect only when AddressIPVersion is set to DualStack. The network type is determined by the value of Ipv6AddressType
Ipv6Address.description_zh:
标识IPv6类型的IP地址。

仅在AddressIPVersion为DualStack时有效，公网或私网IP地址由Ipv6AddressType决定

Ipv6AddressHcStatus.description_en:
The health status of the private IPv6 address of the ALB instance. 
This parameter is returned only when the Status of the zone is Active.Valid values:

Healthy

Unhealthy
Ipv6AddressHcStatus.description_zh:
应用型负载均衡实例IPv6地址探测状态。

只有可用区的状态为Active时才返回。取值：

Healthy：健康。
Unhealthy：异常

Ipv6LocalAddresses.description_en: The IPv6 link-local addresses. The IP addresses that the ALB instance uses to communicate with the backend servers
Ipv6LocalAddresses.description_zh: IPv6 Local地址列表。ALB与后端服务交互使用的地址列表

LoadBalancerAddresses.title_en: 固定VIP模式下，负载均衡在此可用区中的地址列表
LoadBalancerAddresses.title_zh: 固定VIP模式下，负载均衡在此可用区中的地址列表

Status.description_en:
The zone status. Valid values:

Active: The ALB instance is running.

Stopped: The ALB instance is disabled. 

Shifted: The ALB instance is removed.

Starting: The ALB instance is starting.

Stopping: The ALB instance is stopping
Status.description_zh:
可用区状态。取值：

Active：运行中。
Stopped：已停止。
Shifted：已移除。
Starting：启动中。
Stopping：停止中

VSwitchId.description_en: The vSwitch in the zone. You can specify only one vSwitch (subnet) in each zone of an ALB instance
VSwitchId.description_zh: 可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区只能使用一台交换机和一个子网

ZoneId.description_en:
The zone ID of the ALB instance.

You can call the [DescribeZones]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189196.html） operation to query the most recent zone list
ZoneId.description_zh:
应用型负载均衡实例的可用区ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeZones]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189196.html）接口获取可用区ID对应的可用区的信息

ZoneMappings.title_en: 负载均衡的可用区资源
ZoneMappings.title_zh: 负载均衡的可用区资源
